title: Jensen Huang Faces Congress on Dec 1: What They Want to Know #Shorts
description:
On 1 Dec 2026 Jensen Huang is due to sit for a closed-door interview with three House committees about a potential breach of national security; Nvidia's general counsel Tim Teter is due on 2 Dec. Separately, the Justice Department leads a criminal investigation into possible export-control violations at Megaspeed.

Sources (checked 24 Nov 2026):
- AP via Boston Globe (1-2 Dec interviews): https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/11/17/business/nvidia-earning-surpass-expecations/
- Digital Trends (1 Dec transcribed interview): https://www.digitaltrends.com/computing/nvidia-rejects-jensen-huang-ceo-comeback/
- AP via PBS NewsHour: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/nvidia-board-unanimously-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-and-chairman
- CNN via KEYT (DOJ leads Megaspeed probe): https://keyt.com/?p=1501435

Allegations mentioned are reports, not proven facts. Our analysis is labelled as such. News, not financial advice.
This video uses an AI-generated presenter (Google Flow) and animations; facts checked against the sources above. Independent channel, not affiliated with NVIDIA.
